verdict.summary: The serializer change correctly matches the relevant Go encoding/json behavior: UTF-8 non-ASCII remains raw, HTML-sensitive characters and U+2028/U+2029 are escaped, and compact separators are retained. The replacement pass is safe over valid JSON output, and close_beads_in_jsonl applies it only to mutated rows while preserving untouched rows verbatim. Tests are non-vacuous: they pin each encoding rule, validate the full committed corpus byte-for-byte, and exercise the real end-to-end mutation path including untouched-line preservation. The targeted self-test passes.
